user.title: Connect to Kinboard
user.description: Enter the address of your Kinboard instance and an integration token. Create the token in Kinboard under Settings → Integrations. It is shown only once.

reauth_confirm.title: Kinboard token no longer accepted
reauth_confirm.description: The token for {base_url} was revoked, rotated or has expired. Create a new one in Kinboard under Settings → Integrations.

reconfigure.title: Change the Kinboard connection
reconfigure.description: Point Home Assistant at a different address, or replace the token. It must be the same family.

error.cannot_connect: Could not reach Kinboard at that address. Check the address and that the instance is running.
error.invalid_auth: Kinboard rejected this token. Check it was copied in full and has not been revoked.
error.missing_scope: This token cannot read family data. Recreate it with at least the family:read scope.
error.unsupported_version: This Kinboard is older than 1.9.0 and does not provide the Integration API. Upgrade Kinboard first.
error.unknown: Unexpected error. Check the Home Assistant log for details.

abort.already_configured: This Kinboard family is already set up.
abort.wrong_family: That Kinboard belongs to a different family. Add it as a separate integration instead.

add_shopping_item.name: Add shopping item
add_shopping_item.description: Adds an item to the Kinboard shopping list.

quantity.name: Quantity
quantity.description: How much, as free text. Accepted for the future; Kinboard does not store it yet.

category.name: Category
category.description: A shopping list category. Accepted for the future; Kinboard does not store it yet.

create_task.name: Create task
create_task.description: Creates a task on the Kinboard task list.

person_id.name: Person ID
person_id.description: The Kinboard person the task is assigned to. Leave empty for the whole family.

due_at.name: Due
due_at.description: The day the task is due. Kinboard keeps the date and drops any time.

priority.name: Priority
priority.description: From 0 to 100. Accepted for the future; Kinboard does not store it yet.

create_note.name: Create note
create_note.description: Pins a note to the Kinboard board.

expires_at.name: Expires
expires_at.description: When the note should disappear. Accepted for the future; Kinboard does not store it yet.

color.name: Color
color.description: The note's color. Accepted for the future; Kinboard does not store it yet.

show_announcement.name: Show announcement
show_announcement.description: Shows an announcement on Kinboard's screens. Not available yet: Kinboard answers "not implemented".

duration.name: Duration
duration.description: How long to show it, in seconds.

target_devices.name: Devices
target_devices.description: Which Kinboard screens to show it on. Leave empty for all of them.

activate_context.name: Activate context
activate_context.description: Switches Kinboard into a context, such as a holiday mode. Not available yet: Kinboard answers "not implemented".

duration.name: Duration
duration.description: How long the context lasts, in seconds.

dismiss_attention.name: Dismiss attention item
dismiss_attention.description: Dismisses something Kinboard is asking the family to look at. Leave the ID empty to dismiss the top item.

attention_id.name: Attention item key
attention_id.description: The item to dismiss, as listed under `items` on the Attention required sensor. Leave empty to dismiss the top item (`top_key`).

add_pocket_money.name: Add pocket money
add_pocket_money.description: Pays pocket money to a child, or takes it away with a negative amount.

entity_id.name: Child
entity_id.description: The child's pocket money sensor. Use this or the person ID, not both.

person_id.name: Person ID
person_id.description: The child's Kinboard person ID, for automations that already have it. Use this or the child's sensor, not both.

amount.name: Amount
amount.description: In currency units: 2.50 means 2.50. Negative takes money away.

reason.name: Reason
reason.description: Shown in the child's pocket money history.

refresh_integration.name: Refresh integration
refresh_integration.description: Asks Kinboard to re-check what needs the family's attention now, instead of waiting for its next scheduled run.

integration_id.name: Integration ID
integration_id.description: Which integration to refresh. Reserved: Kinboard currently re-checks everything.

show_camera.name: Show camera
show_camera.description: Puts a camera full screen on Kinboard's wall displays, live and muted, and sends a push to the family's phones. The displays go back on their own.

camera.name: Camera
camera.description: The camera's ID or its exact name, as Kinboard shows it under Settings → Cameras.

duration.name: Duration
duration.description: How long to show it, in seconds. Leave empty for Kinboard's default of 60.

target_devices.name: Devices
target_devices.description: Which Kinboard screens show it, by device ID or exact name. Leave empty for every wall display.

request_reward.name: Request reward
request_reward.description: Asks for a reward for a child, as the child's own "Redeem" on Kinboard does. It only asks: nothing is spent until a parent approves it on Kinboard with the settings PIN, and a parent may decline it. The family's phones are told.

child.name: Child
child.description: The child's name as Kinboard shows it, or their Kinboard person ID.

reward.name: Reward
reward.description: The reward's title as listed in Kinboard under Settings → Creatures & rewards, or its ID.

show_camera_forbidden.title: Kinboard cannot show the doorbell camera
show_camera_forbidden.description: {doorbell} rang, but Kinboard ({family}) refused to put its camera on the screens: the integration token does not have the "send messages" permission (`announcements:write`). In Kinboard, under Settings → Integrations, create a token that has it, then enter it here with Reconfigure. This message goes away by itself the next time a doorbell shows its camera.
